verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Elastic Observability has prebuilt dashboards and lets users create alerting rules, but nothing documents defining dashboards or alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) or provisioning them repeatably. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path. Since dashboards-as-code is a fair question for an observability platform, the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define dashboards and alerts as code (JSON models, Terraform, or API) and provision them repeatably
